note: Aperture sums with a local sky annulus, no aperture correction: compare points with each other, not with catalogue magnitudes. Wavelength is the filter centre at the source's pixel in that exposure.
wing_note: Flux in a ring around the core, for stars whose core saturates. Tracks brightness over time; the ring holds a different share of the light at different wavelengths, so don't read spectral shape from it.

error_model.note: Single-exposure errors: err² = (scale·σ)² + (floor·flux)², per detector and method, fitted on constant field stars (scale never below 1). The absolute floor is the star-to-star spread against 2MASS/WISE.

psf.method: forced fit of SPHEREx's official ePSF (EPSF table of the level-2 files, nearest detector region), amplitude only, pixels within 18.5" of the source, local sky from the aperture annulus, Gaia neighbours within the fit fitted at the same time; flux is the total in the 33x33 ePSF box
